gaps.sentence: He was offered ___ job in the human resources department.
gaps.explanation: 'A job' — first mention of one of many possible jobs. Note: 'in human resources' takes no article.

gaps.sentence: He earns fifty thousand pounds ___ year.
gaps.explanation: 'Fifty thousand a year' — 'a' = per in rates.

gaps.sentence: They're building ___ new library near the town hall.
gaps.explanation: A new library — first mention; the town hall is the known one.

gaps.sentence: She's got ___ few friends in Madrid, so she visits often.
gaps.explanation: 'A few' means some (positive); 'few' alone means hardly any.

gaps.sentence: She has ___ excellent command of Japanese.
gaps.explanation: 'Have an excellent command of' — 'excellent' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ only person to solve the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: 'The only person' — 'only' makes the noun unique, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: He had ___ operation on his knee last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Operation' starts with a vowel sound, so 'an operation'.

gaps.sentence: ___ weather was so bad that the match was abandoned.
gaps.explanation: The weather is always definite in a situation.
